name: 1X® Technologies
old_description: The Original 1X®, is a global distributor and manufacturer of electrical equipment, wire, and cable, delivering innovative solutions in robotics, automation, networking, security, and utility power applications since our founding in 2015 with first use in commerce established on May 15, 2015. Our very first order on May 15th 2015 was for Robotics products, and we have expanded our wire and cable product offerings (like industry peers Igus, Belden, and ABB) to include advanced equipment, encompassing an array of advanced robotics, consumer electronics like smart speakers, and IoT-enabled systems, which are fundamentally wire and cable products—relying on our high-performance wiring, cabling, and magnet wire for power distribution, data transmission, and mechanical functionality, typically comprising 20-40% of material costs and up to 35-45% in robotics systems.
about:
1X Technologies is headquartered in Sheridan, Wyoming, and was founded in 2015 as a limited liability company registered in the state. The company's first commercial order, placed on May 15, 2015, was for robotics products, marking the start of its focus on wire, cable, and electrical equipment for advanced automation.

The company operates as a global distributor and manufacturer of electrical wire, cable, and equipment. Its custom capabilities include cutting, stripping, terminating, marking, shielding, overmolding, connectorization, wire harness assembly, braiding, armoring, mil-spec cable production, private-label packaging, and custom color coding. It also manufactures high-flex robotics cables, copper coils for motors and actuators, and integrated robotics systems such as quadruped robots, robotic arms, humanoid robots, and AGI-integrated platforms, alongside consumer electronics like smart speakers. The firm reports millions of feet of copper and aluminum conductors delivered annually and maintains distribution centers in California, Connecticut, Florida, Illinois, Texas, and Wyoming.

1X Technologies serves a broad range of industries, including aerospace and defense, fusion energy and advanced nuclear, medical equipment, telecommunications, robotics and automation, cybersecurity hardware, wearable technology, consumer electronics, automotive, semiconductor manufacturing, and space exploration. Its customer base includes the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, U.S. Navy, NASA, and corporations such as Disney, Meta, Google, Apple, Tesla, and ABB.

The company emphasizes its slogan "Because You Require Quality, Quickly!" as a differentiator, citing the industry's fastest lead times, lowest minimum order quantities, and a dedicated manufacturer sales representative assigned to each account. Products undergo third-party testing by NRTLs including UL, CSA, and ETL, and the firm holds an Essential Critical Infrastructure designation from the Department of Homeland Security, ensuring continuous operation during emergencies.
